title: ManagedTool

name.description: A managed tool, by the name it is found under on the PATH: claude (claude in your terminal, never the bundled binary), bao (OpenBao), vault (Vault), doppler, op (1Password), bws (Bitwarden Secrets Manager) or gh (GitHub).

label.description: What a row calls the tool.

minimum.description: The oldest version the harness works with.

verify.description: The command that proves the tool works, as the fixed arguments after its name.

provider.description: A key manager's provider: openbao (OpenBao or Vault), doppler, onepassword (1Password) or bitwarden (Bitwarden Secrets Manager).

oneOf.description: Required while a connection of the provider injects; any tool for the provider satisfies it (bao or vault for OpenBao).
Required while a forge account reads its token from the environment's gh.

anyOf.description: A tool that can be required, with its minimum and its verify command.
